title: docs(skills): objectstack-ui teaches the record page as the Console ships it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao3RTKFDeacUTyxyZSaPbuLw)_

Fixes #27059

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** `skills/objectstack-ui` 新增一份按顺序讲记录页的规则文件 `rules/record-page.md`(六条:对象声明产出页面 → 关系标志塑造关联列 → slotted 页只覆盖一个槽位 → `kind: 'full'` 是逃生口 → 默认抽屉、对象声明才整页 → 读者自己的选择不是元数据);`SKILL.md` / `rules/pages.md` / `rules/navigation.md` 里写着 Details / Related / Timeline 三页签的旧句子换成一行指针;新增一份 eval;文档站「How a list opens a record」改成现行的打开方式与读者自选项,记录页一节补上关联面板的读者排布。
- **为什么改:** 主干的记录页已是页签行 + 右栏(#28116、#28394),skill 还在教三页签、`tabs` 槽位和 `modal` / `split` / `popover`;照着写的 AI 会为「线索页把任务放最前」去写整页,而正确答案只是子对象外键上的 `relatedList: 'primary'`。
- **风险与回滚:** 纯教学文本加一条 ratchet 行,无 schema、键或运行时改动;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md`,再看 `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 新增的那一行及其出处注释。
- **两分钟验证:** `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`、`pnpm check:role-word`、`cd ui && node scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`;再读 `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json` 的两道题,确认各只有一个正确答案。
- **需要你做的:** Tier H(governed `skills/**`):席位 ACCEPT + 同 head 契约 PASS 后经 os-zhuang 批准;批准同时覆盖为新文件定价的 CEILINGS 行(ratchet 脚本对新行印 ⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY,此处依卡 #27059 的 40 行预算与座席「记录页单独一份规则文件」的裁定写入)。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md`** (new, 65 lines). Six numbered items, read in order, each the remedy for the one before it: (1) the object's declarations produce the page (`nameField`, `highlightFields`, `stageField` with option `kind`, `fieldGroups` + `Field.group`, `relatedLists`, `editMode`), and the surface's width lays it out (two columns from 760 px, three field columns from 1120 px, one column below; a tab row that enlarges one panel at `?related=object.field`; no per-surface layout key); (2) the relationship flags shape the related column (`relatedList: 'primary'` body table / `true` panel / `false` off, `relatedListTitle`, `relatedListColumns`, `relatedListFilter` AND-composed with the parent condition and honoured by the count, rows in the child's default list-view `sort`, the parent's `relatedLists` order) — "put the tasks first on the lead page" is `relatedList: 'primary'` on `task.lead`, no page file; (3) `kind: 'slotted'` overrides one of six slots, each whole, no `tabs` slot (`slots.tabs` / `slots.related` / `slots.relatedLists` refused), `isDefault`; (4) `kind: 'full'` is the escape hatch; (5) the drawer unless the object's list view declares `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` (`new_window`, `none`; `modal` / `split` / `popover` removed in 18.3.0 and refused; field count never decides; a phone always pages); (6) the reader's own choices are not metadata (Open records split / drawer / page, the ⊟ right column per object, the panels' order and hidden set per user × object, the pane's width and ⤢; the `size` bucket only nudges the drawer's starting width). One `<!-- os:check -->` example: `Field.masterDetail('lead', { relatedList: 'primary', relatedListFilter: … })` on a `controlled_by_parent` child.
- **`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`.** The two related-list paragraphs that taught a Details / Related / Timeline tab strip, a shared Related tab and the removed `relatedLayout` keys become a two-line pointer at the new file; one Detailed Rules link; the CRM blueprint's "Record pages" row now says the page is synthesized and a `*.page.ts` is for a slotted slot or a `kind: 'full'` layout.
- **`rules/pages.md`**: the `tabs`-slot sentence is a one-line pointer. **`rules/navigation.md`**: the Surface bullet points at §5–6 of the new file and no longer promises a mobile page or a record `Page` for layout; the Overlay-width bullet moved into §6 whole.
- **`evals/record-page.json`** (new) + a README bullet. Eval 1: tasks first on the lead page → `relatedList: 'primary'` + `relatedLists`; never `definePage`, `slots.tabs`, `kind: 'full'`. Eval 2: contracts open as a full page, and "open beside the list" → `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` on the list view and the Display menu for the reader; never `mode: 'split'` / `'modal'` / `'popover'` / `definePage`.
- **`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`.** A CEILINGS row for the new file pinned at its landed count (996) with its provenance (the card's budget, the seat's ruling, the 403 tokens the three rows below gave up). `SKILL.md` 3851 → 3544, `rules/navigation.md` 2273 → 2197, `rules/pages.md` 5692 → 5669, each lowered to the measurement.
- **`content/docs/ui/views.mdx`** "How a list opens a record": the live modes (`drawer` default, `page` by declaration, `new_window`, `none`; `modal` / `split` / `popover` removed in 18.3.0, `os migrate meta --from 17` drops a stored one; a phone always pages), the reader's **Open records** choice (Split default / Drawer / Full page, kept in the browser, not offered for a page-declared object, ↗ always the full page), the pane's edge, ⤢ / Open as full page / Collapse to drawer, the `size` bucket. **`content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`** record pages: the related panels are the reader's to arrange (⠿ / ⌥↑ ⌥↓, hide, bring back; per user × object). Both pages are the redirect targets of the two guide pages the card names (`/docs/guide/slotted-pages`, `/docs/guide/user-state-persistence`, `apps/docs/redirects.mjs`).
- **`.changeset/27059-skills-record-page-rules.md`**: `@objectstack/skills` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Why

`main` ships record page v4 (#28116 right column + ⊟, #28394 tab row, #28477 phone pass) and @objectstack/spec 18.3.0 retired `modal` / `split` / `popover` and the `tabs` slot, but the published ui skill still taught the three-tab page, a `tabs` slot and the retired modes — so an agent writing from the skill authored a full page for a one-flag change and metadata for choices that belong to the reader. The card asks for one ordered 「记录页」 section that teaches what `main` ships now and an eval that catches the full-page reflex.

## Line budget

PM-set and binding: the package's hand-authored markdown (`SKILL.md` + `rules/*.md`) grows by at most 40 lines; paid with the sentences the retirements made false.

| File | Lines before | Lines after | Δ lines | Tokens before | Tokens after |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `SKILL.md` | 307 | 287 | −20 | 3851 | 3544 |
| `rules/actions.md` | 204 | 204 | 0 | 2258 | 2258 |
| `rules/dashboards.md` | 464 | 464 | 0 | 6259 | 6259 |
| `rules/list-views.md` | 311 | 311 | 0 | 3129 | 3129 |
| `rules/navigation.md` | 162 | 157 | −5 | 2273 | 2197 |
| `rules/pages.md` | 428 | 427 | −1 | 5689 | 5669 |
| `rules/record-page.md` | — | 65 | +65 | — | 996 |
| **Package** | **1876** | **1915** | **+39** | **23459** | **24052 (+593)** |

Tokens are the ratchet's own reading (`ceil(bytes / 4)`, the SKILL.md stamp line excluded). Outside the teaching set: `evals/README.md` 36 → 40 lines, `evals/record-page.json` new (40 lines).

## Tests

Run in the worktree at head 198adea5, stdin closed, exit captured before any pipe:

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` → every objectstack-ui row at or under its ceiling: `SKILL.md` 3544/3544, `rules/navigation.md` 2197/2197, `rules/pages.md` 5669/5669, `rules/record-page.md` 996/996 (headroom 0 each); `--self-test` 97 cases pass. Exit 0 / 0.
- `cd ui && node scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` → every `must_contain` token of `evals/record-page.json` is taught by the bundle (`relatedList: 'primary'`, `relatedLists`, `navigation: { mode: 'page' }`, `Display menu`); 0 untaught rows. Exit 0.
- `pnpm check:role-word` → "OK, no new occurrences of the reserved word" (318 files; baseline 48 files / 156 occurrences unchanged). Exit 0.
- `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness` → Leg 1: 486 citations over 71 files checked, Leg 2: 8 sections, 0 gaps. Exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` → 278 marked examples across 114 files type-check against the dts build of `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/client-react...` (built with `env -u OS_SKIP_DTS` under the verify lock, VERDICT command-exit 0); the new `Field.masterDetail('lead', { relatedList: 'primary', relatedListFilter: … })` block included. Exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-security-posture` → 32 `ObjectSchema.create` examples in 259 marked blocks carry an `os validate`-clean posture. Exit 0 (the first run refused the example for `security-owd-unset`; the second commit declares `sharingModel: 'controlled_by_parent'`).
- `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs`, `check:docs`, `check:liveness`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:docs-redirects`, `check:doc-anchors` → exit 0 each.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` → manifest present and intact (sha256 029ea9f8fca7…, 106 components). Exit 0.
- Eval read-through: eval 1's model answer contains `relatedList: 'primary'` and `relatedLists` and none of `definePage` / `slots.tabs` / `kind: 'full'`; eval 2's contains `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` and `Display menu` and none of `mode: 'split'` / `mode: 'modal'` / `mode: 'popover'` / `definePage`.

## Acceptance notes

- The card names `skills/objectstack-ui/references/pages.md`; that path does not exist (`references/` holds only the generator-owned `_index.md` and `react-blocks.md`). The page rules live in `rules/pages.md`, edited here.
- The two guide pages the card names were folded by K2 into `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx#record-pages` (already current for the tab row, the tiers and the slot table) and `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` (the stale half, rewritten here); no page moved, so no generated reference regenerates.
- The card's ruling 2 (a per-user *timeline column* switch) is superseded on `main` by #28116: 动态 is the right column's first panel, never a column, and the reader's switch is the right column (⊟, `⌘⇧,`) plus the panel arrangement. The skill teaches what ships, per the dispatch.
- Every rule sentence names a `main` code path at 8c3f9d93: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordPageColumns.ts` (760 / 1120 px tiers), `RecordTabRow.tsx` + `synth/recordTabRow.ts` (the tab row, `?related=`), `synth/relatedArrangement.ts` (order / hidden per user × object), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` (the view's `navigation`, else drawer whatever the field count; a phone → page), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordOpenPreference.ts` (`split` default, drawer-mode objects only), `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` `NavigationModeSchema` (the 18.3.0 retirements and their fix), `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` (six slots, `tabs` retired, `isDefault`), `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` (`relatedList*`, the inherited sort), `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` (`nameField`, `highlightFields`, `stageField`, `fieldGroups`, `relatedLists`, `editMode`).
- Out of this PR's file surface, two places still say "Details tab / shared Related tab": `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` (the `relatedList` tri-state bullets) and the `relatedList` `.describe()` text in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, which ships to the generated references. Carrier: ui seat 1 (the first is a sibling skill with its own ratchet row, the second is spec text); not touched here.
- The four files PR #28488 holds open (`rules/actions.md`, `rules/dashboards.md`, `rules/list-views.md`, `evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`) are untouched, per the seat's overlap ruling.
- The new CEILINGS row: the ratchet prints ⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY for a file carrying no ceiling. It is written here under the card's PM-set line budget and the seat's ruling that the record page gets its own rules file, pinned at the landed count with the deletions that pay it down named; the Tier H approval of this PR is the maintainer's say on it.
- The word "role" does not appear in the new file (`check:role-word` baseline unchanged); the ADR is cited by number only.

- Derived: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against this diff → 87 commands (54 pnpm, 33 node). Every one run with `</dev/null`, its exit code recorded on disk as `<command> :: exit <code>` before any pipe.
